scenarios.name: Apply a feature suppression change through the model-state table

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has an extrusion suppressed in Primary and computed in Copy State
the active view representation permits the extrusion's solid body to be visible
the user opens the model-state table
changes the Primary extrusion cell to Compute
the solid produced by the extrusion is visible
the user reopens the model-state table
the Primary extrusion cell displays Compute
the user changes the Primary extrusion cell to Suppress and accepts the table
the solid is absent from the viewport
the extrusion row is struck through
the extrusion row is no longer struck through
